rows.GENERAL RULES: These are general rules that apply to ALL suppliers and are a reference for the AI Order Entry Trainer
rows.SUPPLIER RULES: These are common supplier specific rules that often apply.  Ask the supplier and keep the ones that are necesary
rows.Product Rules: These are a products and possible alternative names for those products

rows.GENERAL RULES: If in doubt about two different products always use the one from the Favourites list and put a note with the product.  If you still can't find it you can try searching in Google for other synonyms.  Please notify Adrian of any synonyms that should be added
rows.SUPPLIER RULES: Supplier Communication Method is: [insert best method of communication and contact details]

rows.GENERAL RULES: Please don't forget to scroll down and review the entire email and PDF (including multiple pages)
rows.SUPPLIER RULES: If there is no date on the order please put tomorrow (today if past midnight in the timezone of the country where the order is!!) but put a comment in additional notes and message the supplier

rows.GENERAL RULES: Please don't forget to scroll down and review the entire email and PDF (including multiple pages)
rows.SUPPLIER RULES:
If someone orders something that you’re not sure of:
- Enter the description under “MISC” code excluding tax 
- Add the ordered product description to the additional notes

rows.GENERAL RULES: If a customer sends 2 different orders with 2 different Purchase Order (PO's) numbers please create 2 different orders
rows.SUPPLIER RULES: Only enter those emails received from start of shift to end of shift

rows.GENERAL RULES: If a customer requests adding to a previous order, only add to an exsiting order when there is no Purchase Order (PO) and when the status is "Submitted".  Do not add to an existing order if the status is "Accepted", please create a new order instead
rows.SUPPLIER RULES: Only enter agreed orders: [All / PDF's / Procure Wizard / Voice messages]

rows.GENERAL RULES: Always double check the date.  On a Friday or Saturday night shift orders can often be for Monday/Tuesday the next week
rows.SUPPLIER RULES: For multiple orders in one email, place each separately

rows.GENERAL RULES: Empty VM's should get sent directly to the supplier (via Whatsapp or their preferred method of communication)
rows.SUPPLIER RULES: Invoice to cash sale if you can't find the customer / Don't place an order if you can't find the customer and notify the supplier by the communication method

rows.GENERAL RULES: At the end of the shift always count how many orders came into the suppliers inbox and how many were entered into Fresho (baring in mind orders where it has been instructed to edit a previous order)
rows.SUPPLIER RULES: If there is a credit note don't enter it into Fresho and forward to the supplier

rows.GENERAL RULES: Always check the Spam folder during the shift
rows.SUPPLIER RULES: Do / do not process orders, if the customer is inactive.  These need to be sent to [supplier email]

IF YOU CANNOT CHECK OUT DUE TO A CHARGED CARD, GO TO THE CUSTOMER TAB, SEARCH FOR THE CUSTOMER'S NAME, AND NAVIGATE TO PAYMENT SETTINGS.   THEN, UNCHECK THE CHARGE CARD OPTION AND SAVE IT. ONCE YOU HAVE COMPLETED THE CHECKOUT, DON'T FORGET TO RECHECK IT AND SAVE AGAIN.
If the customer orders a specific number without specifying the unit of order (ie. 4 Broccoli) please always put the Each
PC = Pieces please put it in as Each
If the customer orders a box but there is no box available use the KG and add 1 KG but add a supplier note saying 1 box
If the customer says no charge (ie. for a credit / replacement) please place the order and put this comment on the Supplier product note and in additional notes
No Deliveries on [insert dates]
Only enter orders up until 10:30PM.
Place additional orders in the same PO that you received in the same shift (4:30 pm), or (10:30 pm) cut-off time
Except if the customer placed the order itself and you received an additional order from them in the email you can go on the separate order this time.
Cash Sales - write all details in external ref others in additoinal notes
ORDERS CONCERNS FORWARDED BY JOE -- NEED TO ENTER
